description: Add a Discord bot (several are supported) without the token ever going through the chat. method "box" (default) asks the app to show a private input box; if the app cannot, or the box is closed, it opens a one-time page on this computer (a http://127.0.0.1 link) where the user pastes the token in their browser. The token is checked and saved, and the bot can be used at once. Call it after the user created the bot (setup_check has the steps).

dry_run.description: Show the requests that would be made without changing anything

label.description: Name to remember the bot by; default: the bot's username

method.description: browser = skip the box and give the page link straight away

name: add_bot
